name: wifi_sta
title: WiFi Station Connection
description: WiFi STA mode connection example. Connects to a 2.4GHz WiFi network, prints IP configuration and signal strength. Includes timeout handling and connection status reporting. Requires user to set SSID and password.
validation_note: NOT verified on hardware. Requires real SSID/credentials and was never run on a board. Validate on your network before relying on it.
